ar.label: Annual Report 2026

verdict.tldr: Infosys demonstrates strong operational discipline and AI adoption, but persistent downward revisions to revenue guidance suggest a struggle to convert record deal wins into immediate top-line growth amidst macro headwinds.

promises.promise: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 1.5% to 3.5% in constant currency terms.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 14.0% and Q2 FY27 growth of 10.7%.
promises.why: Management cut guidance twice: first to 1.5-3.0% in Q1, then to 1-2% in Q2.

promises.promise: Maintain operating margin guidance at 20% to 22% for FY27.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show operating margins held steady at 24.0% for Q1 and Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Actual margins consistently exceeded the top end of the guided 20-22% range.

promises.promise: Hire approximately 20,000 college graduates for the full year FY27.
promises.actual: Management reiterated the 20,000 target in Q2 FY27, matching FY26 levels.
promises.why: Target remains unchanged despite revenue guidance cuts.

promises.promise: Build a team of 6,000 Frontier Engineers over the next few years.
promises.actual: No specific update on current headcount of Frontier Engineers provided in Q2.
promises.why: This is a multi-year target initiated in Q1 FY27.

promises.promise: Maintain margin guidance while reinvesting operational savings into AI capabilities.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show operating margins remained stable at 24.0% through Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Margins held steady despite increased AI investments.

credibility.line: Management is reliable on margins but consistently over-optimistic on revenue, requiring sequential guidance cuts in FY27 despite record deal TCV.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: AI revenues are growing rapidly and reaching significant scale.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: AI revenue rose from 5.5% in Q3 FY26 to 10.5% in Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Strong large deal momentum with $5.2 billion TCV in Q2 FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show revenue growth slowed from 14.0% in Q1 to 10.7% in Q2.
Reported numbers show actual margins have been 24.0% for five consecutive quarters.

bull.point: Exceptional cash flow generation and quality.
bull.evidence: Operating cash is 1.10x reported profit over 5 years.
AI revenues reached 10.5% of total revenue in Q2 FY27.

bull.point: Robust balance sheet with minimal leverage.

bear.point: Sequential weakening of revenue growth guidance.
Potential revenue deflation from AI productivity.
bear.evidence: Management gave partial/evasive answers on AI productivity pass-throughs.

bear.point: Significant contingent liabilities and legal risks.
bear.evidence: ₹3,117 crore in unacknowledged tax claims and DOJ investigation.

watch_next: Stabilization of FY27 revenue guidance in the next quarter.
Impact of wage hikes on the 24% operating margin floor.
Conversion of $5.2 billion large deal TCV into reported revenue.
